author: ExoaRu
body:
dolan_duk 
The reason I was banned was due to my constant disrespect, constant capitalization.

I understand I have a bad reputation, I constantly get into trouble or I'm just enjoying my time on  the server. Today as I was playing the in-game staff, and my friends and I are constantly complaining about their lack of activity, or lack of getting involved in situations, decided to ignore the fact, although multiple people complained about constant Spleefing, of course I was one of the 'victims' in the massive spleef fest, I was losing a constant amount of time, and armor attempting to attack the enemy base, whilst my team decided Hey, let's go spleef random kids for fun! and you can check the logs so you know I was getting spleefed as well as multiple other people. 
I do think I deserved a punishment for my excessive swearing but as I confronted Snowy, he didn't show any signs of doing his job until he noticed me spamming chat, which I also understand was a bad way to get their attention. I apologize still, it's just they don't do their job 1/2 the time so it's a bit annoying. 
I eventually did /report but I was banned a second after, seeing then I talked to Snowy, he still - showing no signs of caring, discussed the situation with me. Helping me understand my wrongdoings but I noticed something off, he never (not sure if he finally has) taken care of the situation, the kids spleefing. The massive amount of hackers, multiple people said they were recording so I don't know if they got it on tape, but it was just Mass Chaos due to the lack of attention put towards the community  trying to enjoy a intense game of DTM, back to the beginning. I was being spleefed - like I said, multiple times. I was annoyed, frustrated with nobody caring or even showing any signs of doing anything, so I kinda flipped my lid and started losing it. When Snowy stepped up to the plate he did NOTHING whatsoever about anybody else but me which I found was a pretty bad job he didn't bother with a warning, telling me to cool it. And handle the other kids spleefing, and hacking. Clearly I was mad nobody was doing anything, so I don't get why that wasn't a warning/temporary ban for like an hour or two. But four days? I think that's way to far especially since all I did was flip out (I clearly understand I did multiple wrong doings) but seriously. He wasn't doing anything - or anybody was doing anything about the big problem. Thank you for your time, and I apologize for my actions. I understand what I did but I hope you can stay in my shoes and realize I was aggravated about the constant overlooking of the big picture. Have a grand morning, -BenjaminJS

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Thanks for the appeal Dolan! Although I am appealing your infraction I will be shortening it to a 2 day temp-ban. I received screenshots of messages you said and they were quite excessive. Taking into account your previous infractions has accumulated to this punishment. Enjoy your day!

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Mod.
